author: Cleo Abram
description:
NASA just announced the astronauts going on the Artemis III mission… 

This is the next step in the plan to put humans back on the Moon and eventually build a Moon base.

This time the crew stays in Earth orbit, practicing the docking that has to work perfectly before Artemis IV lands on the Moon…

To see more about that, subscribe!

#NASA #space #Artemis #moon #science
title: New Artemis III Astronauts Just Announced
